examples.knowledge_point: Identifying a Complex Number Represented by an Argand Diagram
examples.problem:
What complex number is represented in the Argand diagram below?

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14035975/assets/79285ea5c9dc4b535b972f40fb16c9deaf57d895b2081eb789d74663525e12d2.png)
examples.worked_solution:
The coordinates of the point are $(-2,3)$.

- The real part of this complex number is $x=-2,$ and

- the imaginary part is $y=3.$

Therefore, the number depicted is $z=-2+3\textrm{i}.$
